ops-x-leadership.label: Loss of Control
ops-x-leadership.expansion: The system is supposed to be yours to run. Right now, it runs you.

ops-x-leadership.label: Credibility at Risk
ops-x-leadership.expansion: Every downstream error traces back to your team. You become the bottleneck everyone blames when comp goes wrong.

ops-x-champion.label: Scapegoat Risk
ops-x-champion.expansion: When a number is wrong and there's no audit trail, you own the error. There's no proof of what the plan originally said.

ops-x-champion.label: Invisible Labor
ops-x-champion.expansion: No credit when it works. Full blame when it doesn't.

ops-x-champion.label: Can't Execute What Leadership Asks
ops-x-champion.expansion: You're stuck telling your manager the system can't do what they need. That's not a tool problem — that's a credibility gap.

finance-x-leadership.label: Loss of Authority
finance-x-leadership.expansion: If comp changes happen without clean financial modelling, the CFO starts questioning whether Finance has a real handle on spend.

finance-x-leadership.label: Blind-Side Risk
finance-x-leadership.expansion: By the time the exposure surfaces at close, it's a problem you're explaining — not preventing.

finance-x-leadership.label: Holding the Bag
finance-x-leadership.expansion: The plan wasn't wrong. You're carrying risk you didn't create.

finance-x-champion.label: Compliance Exposure
finance-x-champion.expansion: If the books are ever questioned, you can't reconstruct what changed, when, or why. That's not a process gap — that's a liability.

finance-x-champion.label: Permanent Catch-Up Mode
finance-x-champion.expansion: You never get ahead. Always cleaning up the last change when the next one lands.

finance-x-champion.label: Every Period Close Has an Asterisk
finance-x-champion.expansion: You can never fully close a period. Every month-end has an open question attached to it.

sales-comp-x-leadership.label: Trust Erosion
sales-comp-x-leadership.expansion: The moment attainment drops overnight without warning, you've lost them. Disengaged reps don't close pipeline.

sales-comp-x-leadership.label: Can't Trust Your Own Data
sales-comp-x-leadership.expansion: When quotas change without version history, you're forecasting off numbers you're not sure are correct.

sales-comp-x-leadership.label: Defending Decisions You Didn't Make
sales-comp-x-leadership.expansion: The comp leader becomes the face of a business decision they had no control over.

sales-comp-x-champion.label: Constant Firefighting
sales-comp-x-champion.expansion: Every new hire, every promotion, every territory change becomes a manual emergency. No system — just you, a spreadsheet, and a deadline.

sales-comp-x-champion.label: You're the Bottleneck
sales-comp-x-champion.expansion: When the process can't handle change, everything routes through you. One error away from a rep disputing their pay.
